title: Join-Messages
description: Let's you customize your join and quit messages.
body:
# Join-Messages
Let's you customize your join and quit messages.

## Requirements
- Java 17+

## Default configuration

```
# Join-Messages plugin v2.0 by BauHD
# Modrinth: https://modrinth.com/project/joinmessages
# Discord: https://discord.gg/Gmxwzz2rA9
join:
  message: "<dark_gray>[<green>+</green>]</dark_gray> <green><player>"
  private-messages:
    - "<green>Welcome!"
  first-join-message: "<dark_gray>[<green>+</green>]</dark_gray> <green><player> <gray>(NEW)"
  first-join-private-messages:
    - "<green>Welcome!"
  enabled: true
quit:
  message: "<dark_gray>[<red>-</red>]</dark_gray> <red><player>"
  enabled: true
```
